flags.message: The event declares moment=distribution, but context has null cutoff/cut_kind and snapshot_provenance=as-stored. The supplied October 5 snapshot includes the August 26 response request and September 24 amicus entry after the August 19 first distribution. I used that supplied forward information set and its frozen baseline band/count, not a reconstructed first-distribution cutoff. This forecast should not be interpreted as conditioned solely on information available at first distribution. No disposition was sought or encountered.
